exchanges: Leading crypto exchanges in one screener

features.title: Our capabilities
features.workspace: Build your own workspaces for any task. The Builder page is a constructor for your perfect setup: assemble workspaces from any tools
features.alerts: Browser, Telegram, phone call — instant notifications about market changes, even when you're away from your screen
features.density: Spot large players in the order book instantly. The density table and on-chart indicator reveal all large orders — filter, highlight significant orders with your own colors, and never miss bounce and breakout points
features.listing: Track freshly launched coins and get instant alerts when they hit exchanges
features.market_research: Create your own lists, mark levels, and set alerts in a flexible watchlist. Filter coins by exchange and find only independent instruments
features.market_map: Keep an eye on any exchange with a dynamic market map. Instantly track top coins by movement, volume, volatility, volume and trade spikes, funding, and many other metrics
